findings.exactQuote: We may add to, remove from, or otherwise modify this Policy at any time, at our sole discretion, and the modified Policy takes effect from the moment it is posted on the Platform.
findings.plainSummary: The company can change this privacy policy whenever it wants, and the changes apply immediately when posted.

findings.exactQuote: We are not obliged to notify you of any modification. It is your responsibility to review this Policy each time you use the Platform. Your continued use of the Platform after any modification constitutes your acceptance of the modified Policy.
findings.plainSummary: The company will not tell you when rules change, so you must check the policy yourself every time you use the app.

findings.exactQuote: when you grant them, we access your precise location (including in the background), contacts, camera, photo gallery, installed application list and SMS for the purpose of reading one-time passwords.
findings.plainSummary: If permissions are granted, the company tracks your location even when the app is closed, reads your contacts, photos, text messages, and list of installed apps.

findings.exactQuote: To personalise the Platform, to recommend products, to determine the prices, offers, coupons and delivery charges shown to you, and to decide your eligibility for pay-later and no-cost instalment facilities.
findings.plainSummary: The company uses your personal information to decide what prices, discounts, and delivery fees to charge you specifically.

findings.exactQuote: To send you promotional communications by SMS, e-mail, push notification, WhatsApp and voice call, including on behalf of third parties.
findings.plainSummary: The company can send you marketing messages and phone calls for itself and for other businesses.

findings.exactQuote: We share your information with our affiliates and partners, with logistics and payment service providers, with sellers listing on the Platform, with marketing and analytics service providers, and with advertising networks.
findings.plainSummary: The company shares your details with third parties, including sellers, delivery providers, payment companies, and advertising networks.

findings.exactQuote: We may store and process your information on servers located in India, Singapore and the United States, and you consent to such transfer.
findings.plainSummary: You agree that the company can transfer and keep your personal data on computers in Singapore and the United States.

findings.exactQuote: We retain your information for as long as it is necessary for the purposes set out in this Policy, for our business purposes, and for such further period as we consider appropriate.
findings.plainSummary: The company keeps your personal data for as long as it feels necessary for its business.

findings.exactQuote: Deleting the application does not delete your account or your information. If you request deletion of your account, we may retain your information in our archives.
findings.plainSummary: Removing the app or asking to delete your account does not mean the company will completely remove your personal information.

findings.exactQuote: We adopt reasonable security practices. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we do not guarantee the security of your information. You use the Platform at your own risk.
findings.plainSummary: The company does not promise that your information is completely safe, and you take the risk when using the app.

findings.exactQuote: Any dispute, claim or controversy arising out of or relating to this Policy, the Platform or your use of it shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered in Singapore, before a sole arbitrator, in the English language. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore.
findings.plainSummary: Any disagreement must be resolved through arbitration—a private legal process to settle disputes outside of court—held in Singapore in English.

findings.exactQuote: You agree that you will bring any claim against us only in your individual capacity, and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, representative, collective or consolidated proceeding. You waive any right to participate in such a proceeding.
findings.plainSummary: You agree to complain only on your own and give up your right to join group legal actions against the company.

findings.exactQuote: No claim may be brought more than one hundred and eighty (180) days after the event giving rise to it.
findings.plainSummary: You lose the right to make any legal claim against the company if you do not bring it within 180 days of the problem happening.
